verdict.rationale: cubic's memory-and-learning docs say it learns team conventions from replies to its comments and remembers them for next time. It also calibrates on thumbs up/down reactions and extracts patterns from senior engineers' historical code reviews. Repo context files (AGENTS.md, .cursorrules) and custom agents add further convention enforcement on future PRs. Community comments question the plain-English-rules approach in principle but report no concrete failure of the memory feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that learned memory persists and is applied, and documentation on viewing or editing what cubic has learned.
